name: livingwords-ai
description: Local desktop AI with trusted, private workflows for serious users.

scripts.dev: npm run build && electron-rebuild --force --only node-pty && node scripts/brand-electron-macos.mjs && node scripts/launch-electron.mjs electron/main.mjs
scripts.pack: npm run build && electron-rebuild --force --only node-pty && node scripts/check-sidecar.mjs && electron-builder --dir
scripts.deploy: npm run build && electron-rebuild --force --only node-pty && node scripts/check-sidecar.mjs && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.test: tsx --test src/core/assistant.test.ts && node --test desktop/chat-scroll.test.mjs desktop/document-diff.test.mjs desktop/folder-context.test.mjs desktop/panel-layout.test.mjs desktop/terminal-context.test.mjs desktop/terminal-readiness.test.mjs desktop/terminal-theme.test.mjs electron/chat-completion-stream.test.mjs electron/context-settings-store.test.mjs electron/context-window.test.mjs electron/conversation-store.test.mjs electron/document-library.test.mjs electron/pdf-text.test.mjs electron/inactivity-timeout.test.mjs electron/model-manager.test.mjs electron/request-queue.test.mjs electron/terminal-manager.test.mjs electron/trusted-renderer.test.mjs scripts/download-desktop-model.test.mjs
